1000000-karma-my-reward-is-a-quiet-life:
Living a perfect life helping others and without committing any wrongdoing, Noah meets his untimely end saving a girl from being hit by an incoming truck.
While he accepts his end, he finds himself not in whatever afterlife awaits, but an enigmatic place only known as “The Cycle.”
Due to his “Perfect” karma of one million, he is transported to a fantastical world of magic, though he chooses a simple, quiet life along a lake. However, when being sent to this second chance at life, one gift is bestowed upon him:
[...Integrating System…]
[Jack-of-All-Trades System Activated.]
From doing push-ups, chopping trees, and even cutting vegetables, every action is its own unique skill, able to be ascended from a meager level of zero all the way to greatness!
a-hunters-legacy-rise-of-the-fallen:
In the grimy Black Hound Tavern, disgraced hunter Kael Veymar drowns his failures in ale, his father’s shattered crest a noose around his neck. When a Fallen beast attacks him—spewing acid and cryptic threats about the Harbinger—he’s saved by Lyria, a rogue huntress with a deadly smile and a glowing amulet: the Fractalis, stolen by Kael’s father.
Their reunion is cut short by Dren, Kael’s former brother-in-arms, who slit Garrik’s throat for the Guild. After a vicious alley fight, Lyria helps Kael escape, but not before a Fallen’s ooze sears his flesh, leaving veins of corruption that **pulse with the Harbinger’s voice.
Seeking answers, they flee to Ms. Miller, an old ally who gifts Kael a sword and a warning: “Find Torin. The skulls will whistle your name.” But the Guild is closing in. At Celestis Rise Dren is humiliated for his failure, while the Dozen Vanguards receive a bone-chilling letter—its author dead, its ink fresh.
The stakes sharpen:
- The Fractalis is not what it seems.
- And Garrik Veymar’s shadow stretches long from the grave.
Now, Kael and Lyria ride toward Godsgrave, where Hunter blades go to die—and where the Harbinger’s eclipse waits to rise.
all-my-beasts-are-legendary:
In the era of Beast Taming, Ye Xuan with his superior Beast Editor, claims that he can turn even a snake into a Divine Dragon that soars across the nine heavens.
Hence, the little monkey he tamed became a Deific Ape.
The little birds he raised became a ginormous roc.
apocalypse-i-can-see-health-bars:
Apocalypse has descended, turning the world into a living hell!
Chaos reigns as bizarre monsters run rampant! Humanity has been reduced to mere rations. One wrong move, and you’ll be torn apart by the zombie hordes!
Lin Fan awakens a superpower: he can now see HP bars, and killing monsters guarantees loot drops!
Just as he was rubbing his hands together, gearing up to go on an epic killing spree, his beautiful female neighbor came knocking on his door:
“Hey sweetie, I’m scared… Can I sleep in your room tonight?”
apocalypse-infinite-supplies-system:
Awakening to a post-apocalyptic world infested with zombies and mutated monsters, Alex makes a startling discovery: he possesses a system that grants him access to unlimited resources every day.
【Congratulations, you've received unlimited bottled water.】
【Congratulations, you've received unlimited 9mm bullets.】
【Congratulations, you've received unlimited cold medicine.】
...
With each system notification, Alex's chances of survival soar while others struggle to stay alive.
As everyone else fights for their lives, Alex finds himself living in luxury, residing in a lavish mansion where he leisurely sips red wine and savors grilled delicacies amidst the chaos of the end times...
betrayed-by-the-succubus-i-raise-a-twelv:
Crossing over to an Otherworld where Beasts and their masters reign supreme, Aster Grant should have been the envy of all as The Chosen One!
His first summoned beast was an Epic-level Succubus!
However, fate plays tricks, and just at the moment of attention from all, the Succubus betrayed him publicly.
“Master, he just offers way too much!”
Then she turned to embrace a rich man, leaving a scene full of ridicule.
Yet, no one knew that Aster Grant awakened a system that could see through the cultivation paths of all Beastbonds!
“If she can't be raised, then it's time to switch!”
Amid the laughter of the crowd, he made a contract with the silver-haired angel deemed a “cripple.”
“A useless Beast Tamer with a Crippled Angel, a perfect match!”
“Don't even dream of rising again in this life!”
But when Silverwing ripped through the sky and Holy Light obliterated other beasts—
Everyone then realized that the Beast raised by Aster Grant were more terrifying than the succubus!
bl-guardians-of-fate:
“I waited for you my entire life... and you were worth every minute.”
Ardyn Lowell normally forgets his dreams. He’s a normal young adult who has good friends and a happy family. He should be contented with his life, but there’s always this nagging feeling of yearning in his heart, a longing for someone that never seems to disappear.
In his dreams, however, he remembers everything. He remembers the man who always visits him, the man who always sits next to him on the edge of the fountain in a beautiful garden. He can never clearly see the face of this man, but the yearning in his heart ceases when he is with him.
But when he wakes up, he forgets the man once again, and the longing in his chest never goes away.
The day of his graduation ceremony comes, and Ardyn is late. Catching traffic on the way, he unexpectedly meets with a major car accident and dies quickly, suddenly.
When he wakes up, he’s in another world.
In this world, there exists a dark, malicious entity that threatens to destroy the entire planet and its people. This is where Summoners come into play.…
creating-the-shura-palace-in-a-fantasy-w:
Song Yang was a Mercenary King in his previous life, killed by a stray bullet. He transmigrated to a world of cultivation, where the ability to control clouds and move mountains is commonplace.
In this life, after taking over the body of a prince who had lost everything, he awakened a system that granted him a legion of thousands of cultivators in the Saint Realm from the start, and thus his story began.
Creating a Shura Palace that made the whole continent tremble as soon as it heard his name.
Be it a Saint from a Holy Land, an Emperor from a Powerful Empire? An ancestor from a powerful family?
No matter who it is, as long as they pay the corresponding price, Shura Palace can kill.

Creatures who descended down from the absolute light to consume all.

deus-necros: Ludwig Heart, the heir to a vast fortune and a life of luxury, craves only one thing: freedom from his gilded cage. But when a plane crash catapults him into a world of magic and danger, he awakens not as the hero he dreamed of, but as a victim in a twisted ritual. Trapped between the ambitions of dark necromancers and the wrath of vengeful gods, Ludwig must navigate a deadly new reality where his life is no longer his own. Stripped of privilege and resurrected as an undead pawn, Ludwig’s fight for survival will determine whether he reclaims his destiny—or becomes a mere footnote in a world of shadows and deceit.
entangled-in-the-night-unable-to-escape-:
【Broken Mirror, Reconciliation + Forced Love + Bittersweet + Redemption + Foster Siblings】
At the age of 15, Sienna Paxton lost her only relative in the world and was taken in by Grandpa Prescott.
It was there that she met a refined and handsome brother—Silas Prescott.
He seemed like a ray of light in her life, illuminating her world.
But later, she discovered that beneath the brilliant light, lay a possessive madman.
Sienna cried and pleaded, “I was wrong. I won’t run away again. You are my most beloved.”
The man laughed, holding her by the waist, “Then show me how you love me.”
Later, Sienna finally escaped.
Five years later, she returned with a new face, assuming the identity of top brain surgeon Chloe Nash.
She thought Silas Prescott wouldn’t find out, and there would no longer be any ties between them.
Yet, unexpectedly, the man pinned her on the bed, smiling playfully.
“Sienna, I don’t recognize you by your face, but by how your body reacts.”
eternally-regressing-knight:
Though it may be a dream weathered, crumpled, fading,

immortality-simulator:
When Li Fan transmigrated into a new world, his life seemed unremarkable. He was moderately well-off, with a wife and children, but nothing extraordinary. Everything changed upon his death, when he awakened the ability Return to Truth: the power to virtualize an entire lifetime’s worth of experiences, run it as a simulation, and return to the age of twenty armed with that knowledge.
With this ability in hand, Li Fan finally saw a chance to pursue the dream he had always harbored: eternal life. In other words, the path of immortal cultivation.
But the world of cultivation was nothing like the paradise he imagined. After countless generations of cultivators plundering heaven and earth, the heavens had struck back. Mortals now carried the Immortal-Mortal Miasma within their blood, a disease that, when encountered by cultivators, led to cultivation decline and death. No technique could be practiced by more than a single person. Calamities descended from the Heavenly Dao without warning.
In such a hostile world, where even the heavens themselves resist immortal cultivation, can Li Fan truly seize eternal life? Or will he meet his final end, his Dao dispersing back to heaven?
infinite-memories-my-f-rank-skill-is-act:
What if death wasn't the end... but just another lesson?
In a world where humanity fights for survival against monsters pouring from dimensional Rifts, Talent is everything. The gifted rise to become legendary Hunters, while the weak are abandoned by society.
When Noah Kurtz, a twenty-two-year-old Hunter, awakens with the F-Rank Talent: Memory, his future is decided before it even begins. A Talent that merely stores memories and learned skills is mocked as the most useless ability imaginable in an age where others wield dragons, storms, and the power to reshape the battlefield.
But the world has judged him too quickly.
Now, ancient ruins awaken at his touch. Forgotten languages flow effortlessly from his lips. Monsters that have slaughtered countless Hunters hesitate before him.
And somewhere beyond the Rifts, an ancient existence that has erased civilizations for countless ages has finally noticed the one thing it could never erase.
The man who remembers.
invincibility-begins-with-mastery-of-fis:

living-with-the-vampire-queen-and-seven-:
Fuitsu is a hopeless high school student. His life takes a bizarre turn when a mysterious dancing woman emerges from his computer, revealing herself as the vampire queen Kavuri, who offers to grant him her body in exchange for his soul.
Before he can agree, Athena, the Goddess of Wisdom, intervenes and drives Kavuri away. Grateful, Fuitsu asks Athena to become his sister, never knowing that one day, she would willingly offer him her full body.
She agrees, gifting him an ancient bracelet inhabited by eight powerful Goddesses: Athena, Kavuri, Demeter, Artemis, Venus, Hestia, Persephone, and Hera. Armed with the wisdom, love, and power of them, Fuitsu shocks his school and begins an unbelievable journey.
lord-of-the-secret-art:

monopolize-my-mysterious-wife:
Who was Quan Jingwu?
He was the prominent figure at the heart of the city, nicknamed “Master Jing,” and he was also the pinnacle “Big Diamond” of the city's social pyramid.
However, one day, the highly esteemed “Big Diamond” got labeled “exclusive” by a woman, someone they regarded as the lowest of the low.
Everyone in the city was left dumbfounded.
And who was Jian Qing?
She was the family's black sheep, rejected as an illegitimate child, and the laughingstock of the aristocratic families.
When she returned, she shone brilliantly; it was time for those who owed her to pay back.
As her multiple identities were unveiled, those who once looked down on her felt like they had been slapped in their faces.
The first time they met, she was as serene as a lotus. She had a composed demeanor, and she made a grand entrance.
The second time they met, she was as fierce as a wild beast. There was a faint smile on her face, but her actions were ruthless and swift.
The third time they met, she was as cunning as a fox. With a simple call of “Little Jing,” she completely captured his heart, leading him onto the path of a doting husband and never looking back.…
mrnobody-i-am-inside-a-webcomic:
Mr. Nobody is just… there.
A background NPC in a romance webcomic named 'Shining Blossom'. He has no face, no name, no real purpose in his life because the writers of the webcomic didn't give him any of that.
He walks, stands, exists in scenes and that’s it. The story never focuses on him.
Until one day, something feels wrong.
He notices it first in small ways. People were looking odd, having similar faces.
Even more scary is that some of them did not have faces.
“Why the hell they don't have faces?”
At that moment, Mr.Nobody saw a faceless guy with an office suit in a reflection of a building glass. It was him.
“What the hell ? Where the hell is my face?”
And suddenly a system window pops out saying ,'' User has awakened his self-awareness that he is an npc in the webcomic 'Shining Blossom'.
“NPC? Me?”
Instead of breaking down, at night, when the story isn’t really “looking,” he creates his own new identity. A pink bunny helmet. A red bike. A new name: The Crimson Bunny Biker. A secret heroic persona.
Can he balance his boring npc life and an action packed secret life?

…

phoenix-destiny:
Lu Mingshu had never believed in fate.
She hadn’t believed in it when her father had remarried and caused her family to break into pieces, nor had she believed in it when she’d been thrown into a valley to perish.
She hadn’t believed in it when she didn’t have any resources to cultivate with, nor had she believed in it when she’d been condemned by everyone.
She climbed up little by little from dust, while her reign soared into the sky, which caused the world to look on in fear!
If justice doesn’t come, I’ll personally obtain it.
If fate disregards me, I‘ll open up a way to survive.
No matter what fate throws at me, I will surely become a phoenix!
“What a ruthless woman. I’m willing to risk my life and limbs for you, willing to be calculative for you – I’m even willing to be an enemy of the entire world for you. Aren’t you moved even a little?”
“That’s right, since I‘m such a ruthless woman, what exactly is it that you like about me?”
